messages.subject: [R GSoC] First Evaluations!
messages.body_plain:
The first evaluation period opened yesterday.

About half of the student evaluations have yet to be completed.
Students, if you don't complete your evaluations you will automatically
fail, and you won't get paid, per Google's program rules.  They don't
take long, so please get it done.

Almost two-thirds of mentor evaluations are not completed. Please have
these done by Thursday (earlier is better).  Google penalizes the
project if these aren't done, so if mentor evaluations are not complete
as we approach the deadline, I will fail your students for lack of
mentor involvement. (Students, you might want to check in with your
mentors and make sure the evaluations are complete). Again, the
evaluations only take 10-15 minutes, please just make the time.  Only
one mentor from each mentoring team can fill out the evaluation and
submit it, so decide who is supposed to submit the evaluation.

Google's deadlines are firm, and there are no exceptions, so please just
get it done.

If students or mentors have any issues or questions, please email me
immediately so that I can help resolve it.

Regards,

Brian
